description: Inner-benchmark tasks consumed by the PromptPotter connector's extract_experiment hook. Each task is one inner-cycle invocation; the outer L1's score for a candidate is composited (per campaign.json::scoring) over TWO proxy metrics per task: first_round_delta (early speed) and after_N_rounds_delta (best depth). Both read the inner cycle's best-DISCOVERED candidate (the θ-LCB of the best candidate the inner search FOUND, discounted by its own SE against winner's-curse), NOT the best it CROWNED — because at any feasible inner sample budget the conservative θ-LCB election rarely crowns, so reading the crowned frontier fed the outer ~zero signal even when the inner loop plainly found better candidates. The whole trajectory is computed in ONE space (θ-implied ability where the ruler is warm, else raw accuracy) so no delta subtracts across scales, and levels are NOT floored at origin, so a regressing meta-prompt yields a negative delta the outer can steer away from (the outer formula is recentred (delta+1)/2 so regression < no-op < improvement all stay distinct instead of piling at the [0,1] clamp). Inner benchmark = justlogic depth-6/7 (~0.44 origin, clear headroom; gsm8k retired — its origin aces target). Target 0.60; paper ceiling on this stratum ~0.81. n_samples_per_inner_round = 24, scored IN FULL per candidate (inner_recursion sets sp_budget_ttest = bank size): drawing more samples than we score just widens the θ-LCB and starves the signal, so draw == measure. 2 inner rounds x 2 inner variants (inner_n_variants, applied by inner_recursion) is the screening geometry. It MUST be >=2: at 1 round the inner `levels` trajectory has a single entry, so first_round_delta (levels[0]-origin) and after_N_rounds_delta (max(levels)-origin) are byte-identical every time and the scoring formula's two 0.5 delta terms silently double-count one number. Two rounds give after_N a real trajectory distinct from first_round_delta, so both proxies carry independent signal — first_round_delta stays the cheap early signal; after_N rewards a meta-prompt whose SECOND round still climbs. TWO proxies retired from scoring (both were dead/anti-signal): rounds_to_N is a constant while origin<target is unreachable in 2 rounds (len(levels)+1==3 on every task -> cancels in the candidate election -> pure 0.2 offset; still COMPUTED for the inner narrative, and re-add to the formula if the target is ever lowered); and the per-seed cost multiplier min(1.0, DIVISOR/tokens) measured the SEED not the candidate (token count is a task-difficulty property applied ~equally to every candidate on a seed, so it carried no candidate gradient and, where it did vary, penalized candidates that explored more) — spend_budget_usd is the real cost control. The added depth roughly doubles inner spend, so the outer spend cap is sized to fit (campaign.json::spend_budget_usd). PANEL = 8 seeds: 2-failure margin over the elimination_n_min (6) coverage floor so one flaky inner tail doesn't waste the run.
